module: "Event Log" window (fg_events) of the Flowgraph editor: log of the project's events (levels Debug, Info, Warning, Error, States) with colors, "Hide Duplicates" options, time format (Project Time, Global Time, Frame) and auto scroll (flowgraph.general.* preferences). Double-clicking an entry linked to a node or graph navigates to it. Returns _flowgraph_createMgrWindow(C).
notes: In handleMeta, the meta.type == 'graph' branch reads e.meta.node.graph while only e.meta.graph is tested: if meta.node is nil, this path would raise an error (inconsistency in the game code).
Used via require, not as a regular extension.

drawContent.desc: Draws the controls (Hide Duplicates, Time Format, Auto Scroll) and the columned list of events.

draw.desc: Draws the "Event Log" window if it is visible.

handleMeta.desc: Handles the tooltip and double-click of an entry that has metadata (node or graph): selects the graph and centers the view.
